items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: we had had some numbers that... Basie used to write... 'Pandussie Stomo'

ctx.x: Right. 'Goin' to Chicago', And then after that we started getting or even before that we had had some numbers that, band numbers that were beginning to 'Miss Thing' and things that Basie used to write. Taps Miller, 'The
World is Mad', 'Down for Double' and 'Digging for Dex and 'Pandussie Stomo and all those things.
All this time though you were having, I mean the difference between this band and we'll say Duke's or Luncefords was that there were a whole lot of different arrangers coming in all the time?
